name: v3_global_h_check
description: Third-round GRAPE bandwidth grid for checking whether the best low-complexity models prefer near-global smoothing.
notes: This grid only checks CFP/ROI S2x2x1 R1, the best low-complexity v2 models.
Signal h values above 1.0 approximate global smoothing on normalized age t in [0,1].
Eligibility uses the same support rule as v1/v2.
